pendingCases: A Stainless Story: --story-shuffle-probe tests whether copied self-shuffle must move the activating Spell instead of the sent monster; current source moves the sent monster. Ruling/intent unresolved.
Ghostrick Oni: the printed Xyz Summon wording and the existing field-to-material implementation still need reconciliation.
Sarifiel: hypothetical effect immunity of a GY material. The --grave-immune-probe reproduces attachment; expected ruling needs confirmation before a production change.
